name: analog-clock-benchmark
description: A vision benchmark that measures a model's ability to read analog clocks from images and report the correct time. It tests visual recognition and basic temporal reasoning from rendered or photographed clock faces, often requiring precise numeric output formatting. Useful for evaluating multimodal models' perception-to-text capabilities.
reputation: A focused, task-specific dataset used by the multimodal research community to evaluate visual time-reading performance; modest but growing use for model probing.
